attempted_claim: Let X be a smooth Fano threefold in Mori–Mukai deformation family №2.5, with its standard del Pezzo fibration X → P¹ whose fibers are normal cubic surfaces. Is X K-stable for every such X, including when a fiber has a Du Val singularity of type D₅ or E₆?
decisive_failure: This report cannot exclude K-stability or instability of MM 2.5 threefolds with D5/E6 fibers: the fiber-flag bound caps at 0.51 (D5) and 0.36 (E6), the off-line 3/2 surface bound is unproven for D5/E6 cubics, the exact line-flag lifts top out at 6/5 and 16/15 below the 4/3 barrier, the lattice reconstruction of line geometry was inconclusive, and the destabilizer search found only positive-beta candidates. All conclusions rest on published lemmas (Cheltsov-Denisova-Fujita; Denisova thesis) plus exact rational arithmetic recorded in WORKLOG; closing the problem needs substantial new valuative analysis beyond this pass.
